source: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 2017 edition, 1:10,000,000 (generalised), via the us-atlas npm package v3.0.1 (counties-10m.json)
note: Generalised boundaries: use a distance tolerance near coastlines and borders. County-equivalents for Alaska are boroughs and census areas as of 2017; the Valdez-Cordova Census Area was split into Chugach and Copper River in 2019.
